> 🔀 Delegated to the **platform** agent

I've started this as task `t_5f3390ba`. The answer will post into this thread as soon as it's ready.

Task `t_5f3390ba` has finished (`done`). Here is its complete result:

## What's wrong
Catalog requests are failing in cluster [`gitops-pilot-20260917-144722`](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/clusters/details/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260917-144722/details?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) because all `search-api` Pods are unready and dropped from Service endpoints.

## Why
- **`search-api` readiness probe misconfigured** — The container listens on port `8085` (`-listen=:8085`), but the `readinessProbe` `httpGet` targets port `9099`, causing health checks to fail (`ContainersNotReady` / readiness probe failed) and blocking catalog traffic.

## What to do
- **Review and merge Pull Request** [PR #41](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/pull/41) against branch `run/gitops-pilot-20260917-144722/b-0022b` to update `tasks/b-0022b/10-workloads.yaml` (`readinessProbe.httpGet.port: 8085`), allowing Argo CD to sync and restore `search-api` endpoints.

## Sources
- `Developer Knowledge MCP (developerknowledge.googleapis.com)` — `documents/docs.cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/troubleshooting/ingress-health-checks`, `documents/docs.cloud.google.com/service-mesh/docs/gateway/configure-readiness-probes`
